{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
df_final = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_rate_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel:")
print(conv_rate_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rate by segment and channel
conv_rate_by_seg_channel = df_final.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print("\nConversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conv_rate_by_seg_channel)

# Compute the difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff_by_seg = conv_rate_by_seg_channel['email'] - conv_rate_by_seg_channel['paid_search']
print("\nDifference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(diff_by_seg)

# Check if email outperforms paid_search in all segments
improvement_in_all_segments = (diff_by_seg > 0).all()
print(f"\nEmail has higher conversion than paid_search in all segments? {improvement_in_all_segments}")"}
